newsitem.title: UK: EDS/Hogg Robinson buys UK's paymaster agency.
newsitem.headline: EDS/Hogg Robinson buys UK's paymaster agency.

text.p: The British government's paymaster agency is to be sold to EDS/Hogg Robinson Plc for 22.7 million stg, junior Treasury Minister Phillip Oppenheim announced on Thursday.
The agency provides pensions and banking-type services to the public sector.

"Supported by the marketing expertise, technical resources and impressive track record of EDS/Hogg Robinson, the staff should now be able to win new work from the private sector to augment their on-going public sector contracts," Oppenheim said.

"Customers can look for even better service from a market leader at lower cost to the taxpayer, whilst pensioners can be reassured that the administration and payment of their pensions will continue to be in highly professional hands," Oppenheim said.

The agency, which has yearly turnover of more than 25 million stg, administers 1.6 million public sector pensions, operates accounts with the Bank of England of 1,400 government departments, agencies and other public-sector organizations, and has comprehensive in-house information technology systems.
